rules.problem: This food contains pork or pork-derived ingredients. Not suitable for halal diet.
action: Do not eat this food.
Find halal restaurants: HalalKorea.com or search 할랄 on Naver Maps
Ask: 할랄 음식 있나요? (do you have halal food?)
Itaewon area in Seoul has the most halal options

rules.problem: This dish may contain alcohol as a cooking ingredient. Common in Korean marinades.
action: Ask: 이 음식에 술이 들어가나요? (Does this have alcohol?)
Choose steamed or boiled dishes — less likely to contain alcohol
Check packaging for 주정 (alcohol ingredient)

rules.problem: This soup is made with PORK BONE broth. Even if you remove the meat, the broth itself contains pork.
action: Do not order this — the entire broth is pork-based
Safe alternatives: 미역국 (seaweed soup), 콩나물국 (bean sprout soup)
Look for restaurants with 소고기 국물 (beef broth) option

rules.problem: This dish appears vegetarian but typically uses anchovy stock (멸치 육수) or fish sauce. Not vegetarian.
action: Ask: 멸치 육수 사용하나요? (Do you use anchovy broth?)
Request: 채소 육수로 만들어 주세요 (Please make with vegetable broth)
Temple food restaurants (사찰음식) serve strictly vegan Korean meals

rules.problem: Korean date formats are different. Make sure you understand which date is which.
action: 유통기한 = best before / sell-by (sometimes still edible after)
소비기한 = use-by / expiry (do NOT eat after this one)
제조일 = date it was made
Format is YYYY.MM.DD

rules.problem: Korean spicy food is MUCH hotter than you expect. Even 'mild' versions can be intense.
action: Start with 순한 맛 (mild flavor) option
Drink milk or eat rice to neutralize spice — NOT water
Say 덜 맵게 해주세요 (please make it less spicy)
